findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "list_services" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "confirm_booking" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: confirm_booking, request_callback, get_payment_handoff_url, request_service, submit_quote_request · Private data: get_credentials, initiate_handoff, submit_quote_request, create_booking_payment_link, cancel_booking · Public sink: reserve_slot, confirm_booking, initiate_handoff, request_callback, subscribe_to_updates, get_payment_handoff_url, request_service, submit_quote_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: confirm_booking, request_callback, get_payment_handoff_url, request_service, submit_quote_request · Private data: get_credentials, initiate_handoff, submit_quote_request, create_booking_payment_link, cancel_booking · Public sink: reserve_slot, confirm_booking, initiate_handoff, request_callback, subscribe_to_updates, get_payment_handoff_url, request_service, submit_quote_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
